definitions.short: Alemeth , the name of a place in Palestine and of two Israelites
definitions.full: H5964. Alemeth עָלֶ֫מֶת 1. proper name, masculine person a Benjamite 1Chr 8:36 ; 9:42 , עָלָ֑מֶת 7:8 ; ᵐ5 Σαλαμαιθ , Γαλεμαθ , Αλαμωθ , etc. 2. proper name, of a location (= עַלְמוֺן q. v.) 1Chr 6:45 Baer Ginsb (van d. H. עַלֶּמֶת ).

occurrences.englishText: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
The sons of Becher: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.
Ahaz became the father of Jehoaddah. Jehoaddah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.
Ahaz became the father of Jarah. Jarah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.
